title: the pre-commit gate spends 28 of its 46 seconds in pipefail_sigpipe_check.sh forking one grep per line over 28,000 lines on every commit of this repository
body:
Measured by cc on 2026-09-18 at a5c507441 by running `.githooks/pre-commit` directly on one staged scratch line with every output line timestamped, twice, at a load of 7 to 13: 46.3 s and 45.5 s wall. The canon Intent gate (four guards, the critic over six languages, the doctor gate) had finished by 0.7 s; everything after is `bin/.devbin/cmd/precommit`'s parity arms, which exist only in this repository. Of the wall, `intent/st/ST0056/parity/tools/pipefail_sigpipe_check.sh` took 28.4 s: its `scan_file` reads each file line by line in bash and forks `grep -Eq "$PAT"` once per line, over 91 instruments and about 28,000 lines, so about 28,000 processes on every commit whatever is staged. The 83 s and roughly 150 s seen on real commits the same morning are this arm under load and lock waits.

## What it costs

Every commit of this repository, by every lane, waits on it. Other estates do not: their gate is the canon gate, one to three seconds on a live store, so the fleet trawl's per-commit cost is not this.

## The fix (S), banked by cc at refs/bank/cc/pipefail/patch

`scan_file` becomes one `awk` per file applying the same ERE: the first-character comment rule, `PAT`, the `path:lineno:stripped` output, the population assertion and the two-sided control are unchanged, and the control drives the new scanner. Measured 28.10 s to 0.29 s for the arm. Old and new bytes driven against a planted file with five shapes (a direct pipe, a commented pipe, a `||` line, a tab-indented multi-stage pipe, a last line with no trailing newline) exit alike and name the same three sites, outputs diffing to nothing. One trap recorded in the bank's note: `awk -v` interprets backslash escapes, so a `PAT` that grows a backslash is caught by the planted-defect control as CONTROL FAILED; `ENVIRON` is the escape-free door if ever needed.
